answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 22904 Country: India Title: My son's name is Baasil, which as per my knowledge means brave, royal. Kindly confirm the meaning and also advice whether it is necessary to add Mohammed or Ahmed to his name? Question: My son's name is Baasil, which as per my knowledge means brave, royal. Kindly confirm the meaning and also advice whether it is necessary to add Mohammed or Ahmed to his name? Answer ID: 22904 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 981/981/M=1431) Basil means: brave, bold and lion. We could not find its meaning as royal and famous in the dictionary. However the name Basil is correct, it is better to add Ahmad or Muhammad with it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
